source.author_body: The CircleSaaS weekly launch starts this Monday, November 2. How the weekly launch works Only 25 startups launch each week, so none get buried. Every launch gets its own week, with a fixed slot on the board. Hall of Fame After your launch week, your startup goes into the Hall of Fame for 30 days. It stays visible on the list for those 30 days. Submit at circlesaasboard.com . P.S. Your tile is permanent from the moment you claim it.

metadata.headline: Looking for 14 new startups to list on CircleSaaS before Monday’s launch

source.decision: Discussion/seller/product research only; no paid buyer or complete competition/contact evidence
